source: Original PR #5/#7 input contracts and retained experiment metadata; external files were not freshly audited.
path_format: External relative_path values retain the recorded POSIX layout; join filesystem components using the host path library.

inputs.name: frozen_assignment
inputs.used_for: Original specimen membership and split; never regenerate a split when reproducing this experiment.

inputs.name: fine_to_broad
inputs.used_for: 32 sponsor categories mapped to the experimental 28 labels.

inputs.name: bound_records
inputs.used_for: Frozen records with Method A split, label IDs and original source image/annotation paths.

inputs.name: model_category_map
inputs.used_for: Interpret model outputs 0..27; COCO labels use 1..28 before loader remapping.

inputs.name: grid_images
inputs.used_for: Existing 1024-pixel LoG-fused train/valid PNGs, linked read-only by the baseline.

inputs.name: grid_plans
inputs.used_for: Original tile positions and known reference boxes for preparation and full-grid evaluation.

inputs.name: grid_dataset
inputs.used_for: COCO annotations, linked images and source_image_hashes.json for the baseline and shared validation.

inputs.name: variant_datasets
inputs.used_for: Prepared A1/A2/A3 COCO datasets and verified summaries; valid links to the baseline validation grid.

inputs.name: source_scans_and_annotations
inputs.used_for: Original NDPI focal series and authoritative NDPA; required for rebuilding source geometry and context crops, not table export.

inputs.name: generic_initialization
inputs.used_for: Training initialization; not one of the fossil-trained final checkpoints.

A1.preparation: Keep original tiles containing a retained known YES box.

A2.preparation: Context crops anchored on originally covered training targets; incidental known labels retained.

A3.preparation: Context crops anchored on all assigned training targets.

distribution: Existing external inputs remain in place; no image data bundle is introduced.
